facts.business: Tipco Engineering India Limited manufactures process equipment such as dispersers, homogenisers, and other industrial machinery for industries including paints, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and coatings.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Interest-free unsecured loans aggregating Rs 242.50 Lakhs (balance outstanding Rs 272.50 Lakhs as on March 31, 2026) granted to relatives of Directors and a firm in which Directors are interested; terms observed as prejudicial to company's interest. Board has decided to stipulate formal terms including interest rate and repayment schedule.

key_risks: High capacity utilisation (89%) at Sonipat facility limiting ability to accept new orders
Related party transactions involving interest-free unsecured loans to relatives of directors and interested firms
Delay in filing/registering charges with ROC
Dependence on public capital for expansion beyond internal accruals
facts.related_party_note: During FY 2025-26, the Company entered into contracts/arrangements with related parties in the ordinary course of business. Except for rent paid to M/S RGVY Enterprises, all other related party transactions were executed on an arm's length basis. The Company granted interest-free unsecured loans aggregating Rs 242.50 Lakhs (balance outstanding Rs 272.50 Lakhs as on March 31, 2026) to relatives of Directors and a firm in which Directors are interested.
